'''''Wanted Poster: Trandoshan''''' was a poster available sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a series of conflicts between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It depicted a photo of a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Unidentified Trandoshan criminal|criminal]]. The [[Aurebesh/Legends|aurebesh]] text, the [[Writing/Legends|alphabet]] of [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], along the top read "WANTED" while the text at the bottom described what his crime was, specifically that he was wanted for atrocities against a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] clan known as [[Strongfist clan|Strongfist]]. The text along the bottom-right side read "HUSSVETH-03." The poster was [[Color/Legends|colored]] in teal green while the text was in red.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Wanted Poster: Trandoshan'' was a poster that appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. It could be looted by the player from the corpses of most any humanoid enemy in the game and became very common with the ''New Game Enhancements'' update in [[November]] [[2005]]. The poster's aurebesh text misspelled both atrocities and Wookiee. The player could use the poster as decoration in one of their personal structures.
